project_type: React + TypeScript single-page web app (no-bundler, import-map ESM). UI to manage a team of AI agents that collaboratively build a web programming project from one user prompt.
build_system: Bun 1.2.14 as transpiler/dev-server (no npm install). TypeScript 5.9.2 global tsc for typechecking. Prettier + ESLint available globally. CRITICAL: npm registry is BLOCKED (HTTP 403) under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, so NO dependency can be `npm install`-ed. React/ReactDOM are loaded in the browser via an ESM import map pointing to a CDN (esm.sh); app source keeps `react`/`react-dom` imports EXTERNAL.
test_framework: Bun's built-in test runner (`bun test`) for pure logic (the mock agent engine / orchestration). No React component test libs are installable, so UI logic that must be tested lives in framework-agnostic .ts modules.
build_command: NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build  (transpiles src/main.tsx to dist/ with --external "*"); plus NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json for typecheck
verification_instructions: 1) `NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` must pass (typecheck). 2) `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` must pass (engine unit tests). 3) `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build` must succeed and emit dist/main.js. 4) Optionally `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run dev` serves on localhost and index.html loads. IMPORTANT: every node/bun/tsc invocation MUST be prefixed with `NODE_OPTIONS=` to unset the broken --require proxy-bootstrap preload, otherwise node crashes with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by `bun run build` and is gitignored. No checked-in generated files.
setup_instructions: No install step possible/needed. Bun, tsc, eslint, prettier are globally available. Just clone and run the verification commands. All runtime npm deps (react, react-dom) are fetched by the BROWSER from esm.sh via the import map in index.html, so the app runs when opened in a browser with internet; the sandbox verifies via typecheck/transpile/unit-tests which are fully offline.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no external network at runtime. npm registry returns 403 - cannot `npm install` or `bun install` anything. No @types/react available, so a local hand-written type shim in src/types/react-shim.d.ts provides the React API surface used by the app so tsc passes offline. NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared on every command (preload module missing). The app cannot call real LLM APIs from the sandbox, so it ships a deterministic MOCK agent engine behind a provider interface.
contribution_requirements: No existing repo conventions (greenfield). README must be in Portuguese (user writes in pt-BR). Include .gitignore. Leave git state clean, ready to commit. Do NOT push or create a PR.
key_patterns: Clean separation: (a) agent-orchestration/engine logic in framework-agnostic TypeScript modules under src/engine (so it is unit-testable with bun test and swappable), (b) an LLMProvider interface with a MockLLMProvider implementation under src/engine/providers so a real backend can be plugged in later, (c) React UI in .tsx under src/ui and src/components that consumes the engine. Agent roles are data-driven (an AgentRole config array) so one AI can hold multiple roles.
relevant_files: package.json (scripts: dev/build/typecheck/lint/format/test; type=module; no deps installed)
tsconfig.json (jsx react-jsx, moduleResolution Bundler, strict, noEmit, typeRoots includes src/types)
index.html (import map mapping react/react-dom to esm.sh CDN; loads dist/main.js as module)
src/types/react-shim.d.ts (local ambient types for React APIs used, enables offline tsc)
src/engine/types.ts (Agent, AgentRole, Task, PipelineState, LogEntry types)
src/ui/App.tsx, src/components/*.tsx (prompt input, agent cards, status/output panels, log)
dev-server.ts (Bun static server that transpiles tsx on the fly for local dev)
directory_structure: /projects/sandbox root holds config (package.json, tsconfig.json, index.html, .gitignore, README.md, .eslintrc, .prettierrc, dev-server.ts). src/engine = testable orchestration + providers. src/ui + src/components = React UI. src/types = type shims. tests/ or *.test.ts next to engine for bun test.
